Find Publishers Already Proven to Convert

FuseTwo helps growing brands find and activate the right publishers, without sorting through low-quality networks or running your own vetting process. Every publisher in the FuseTwo network is reviewed for audience fit, industry relevance, and conversion track record before you ever see them.

Most partner platforms give you a list and let you figure out the rest. FuseTwo ranks publishers by how well they match your category, your audience, and what’s already performing in your program, so you’re choosing from a list that makes sense, not scrolling through noise.

Partner quality drives ROI more than partner volume. FuseTwo learns what’s working in your program and keeps refining its recommendations, so the longer your program runs, the sharper your partner mix becomes.
Launch Partner Programs Faster with Automated Onboarding
FuseTwo cuts partner onboarding from weeks to days. Contracts, creative assets, tracking setup, and compliance checks are all handled inside the platform. New partners go through each step with ease.

When onboarding drags, partner programs stall before they start. Partners lose momentum, and brands lose the window. FuseTwo keeps everything moving in parallel, so by the time a partner is approved, they’re ready to go live.
Most growing brands don’t have a dedicated program manager. FuseTwo is built for this; the platform handles the process work in the background while your team stays focused on strategy and growth.
Track Every Touchpoint in the Partner Marketing Journey

FuseTwo tracks how your partners contribute to revenue at every stage, from first discovery to final conversion. Last-click attribution misses too much: zero-click behavior, multi-touch journeys, and the partners who influenced a decision without getting credit for it. FuseTwo shows you the full picture.
FuseTwo pulls your partner performance into one reporting view so you’re not reconciling numbers across five platforms or manually building decks before every budget conversation.
When leadership asks what’s working, you’ll have a real answer. Good attribution isn’t just a reporting feature. It makes every budget decision defensible and every next move clearer.
Protect Your Partner Programs from Fraud and Non-Compliant Traffic

FuseTwo monitors your partner program around the clock: flagging invalid traffic, suspicious activity, and compliance issues before they hit your budget or skew your data. Every publisher in the platform is held to defined standards, and anything that looks off gets surfaced in real time.

Bad traffic doesn’t just waste budget, it poisons your attribution. When fraudulent clicks make it into your data, every decision downstream gets a little less reliable. FuseTwo keeps both your spend and reporting clean.

To trust your partner channel, you need to trust the numbers it produces. FuseTwo’s fraud protection makes sure what you’re seeing reflects what’s actually happening, not inflated activity from partners gaming the system.

FuseTwo automates the routine work that eats up your team’s time: commission management, performance triggers, partner communications, and campaign adjustments. Growing brands can run a sophisticated partner program without adding headcount to manage it.

As AI changes how people discover and buy, your partner program needs to keep up. FuseTwo responds to performance signals in real time: acting on what the data shows, flagging what needs your attention, and handling the rest so you don’t have to.

Less manual work doesn’t mean less control. FuseTwo’s automation gives you full visibility into what’s running and why. The platform handles execution; your team focuses on the decisions that actually need them.
Launch and Manage Partner Programs from One Platform

With FuseTwo, you can set up and run your entire partner program from one place: commission structures, partner tiers, creative guidelines, performance benchmarks. No juggling three platforms. No spreadsheets or manual handoffs.

Too many brands cobble together partner programs across tools that don’t talk to each other. The result is slow setup, inconsistent data, and reporting gaps that are hard to explain. FuseTwo brings everything into one workflow so setup is fast and managing it stays manageable.
Growing brands move fast and run lean. FuseTwo is built for that reality, so when you’re ready to launch, the platform is already set up to support you without the drag that slows most teams down.
